item.title: Victorian jewel showcases lifestyle bygone era
item.description: MODESTO — The McHenry Mansion in downtown Modesto is an unparalleled treasure from the Victorian era. Architectural aficionados would emphasize it is a fine example of “Victorian Italianate styling.”

item.title: Ripon installing two EV chargers outside city hall
item.description: Valley 29 Electric will handle the Electric Vehicle Charging Station Project for the City of Ripon. No discussion was needed at the Dec. 9 Ripon City Council meeting on the approval of bringing aboard Valley 29, which was among eight bidders for the project.

item.title: Manteca, Lathrop & Ripon all offer free Christmas tree pickup
item.description: Now that the holidays are almost over, what do you do if you have to get rid of a real Christmas tree? Local cities offer free Christmas tree collections.

item.title: Newsom’s grand experiment for Medi-Cal for all illegal migrants sickens the State’s finances
item.description: This past Friday was the final hurrah for workers for the nonprofit Mayor’s Fund for Los Angeles to canvass LA looking for immigrants living in the United States illegally. Their mission was to use iPads and clipboards to sign up as many illegal migrants as possible for Medi-Cal. It is something they have been doing on Fridays since the start of October.

item.title: Ceres Police pursuit ends with arrests in Manteca
item.description: Four suspects wanted in connection with a Ceres home invasion were arrested in Manteca on Sunday.

item.title: NEW LATHROP LANDING PARK
item.description: Lathrop Landing Community Park is “substantially” complete.

item.title: California Keys help usher in 2026 with 2 shows at Dead Puppy Comedy Club
item.description: The most unique New Year’s Eve Party this year in Manteca will arguably take place at the Deaf Comedy Club. The California Keys — dueling pianos — are the feature of two shows at 8 p.m. and 10:15 p.m. Wednesday at the downtown comedy club at 127 North Main Street.

item.title: Gas station plan includes space for three restaurants
item.description: The developer of a Chevron gas station with an Extra Mile convenience store and car wash wants to use it as a linchpin to create a neighborhood dining destination.

item.title: SHARP volunteers serve community & help free up police
item.description: Some time, just after the city open up from Covid 19, I started a series called, ‘Inside SHARP’. The purpose was to generate more interest in our group. For one reason or another I never got past the first article.

item.title: ‘THE WALL’ COULD BECOME ‘THE CORNER’ DURING 2026
item.description: Ground zero for changes to downtown Manteca in 2026 could easily be the intersection of Yosemite & Sycamore avenues.
